issue.title: [FRR]In multipath scenario when a route is advertised through network command from two neighbors, only one path is chosen.

failure.body:
#### Description
In multipath scenario when a route is advertised through network command from two neighbors, only one path is chosen. Doing clear bgp * will help to recover the scenario

If the same route (be it default or non-default) is advertised from two leaf to a ToR, the leaf initially shows only one leaf's links as next hop. When we do clear bgp *, it is then updated. I did the experiment advertising <IP>/32 from  leaf the ip route in tgnToR where it shows only paths to one of the leaf.

B>* <IP>/32 [20/0] via <IP>, PortChannel1, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel2, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel3, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel4, weight 1, <IPV6>

After doing clear bgp * in tgn-sonic-n2-t1 I can see this

B>* <IP>/32 [20/0] via <IP>, PortChannel1, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel2, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel3, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel4, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel5, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel6, weight 1, <IPV6>

  *                    via <IP>, PortChannel8, weight 1, <IPV6>

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Perform advertise of a network from two network
2. Check show ip route in the neighbor
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
Only one of the paths is chosen.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Both paths should be chosen in ECMP scenario.
